blocks.x: Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
A top-3 grocery retailer (800+ stores) — Retail & Consumer Goods engagement delivered by a 17-person team over 13 months, Europe scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Fresh ordering anchored to history; waste and stockouts coexisted by category.
Cold-chain evidence manual; spoilage discovered at expiry.
Markdown timing by manager instinct across 800 stores.

blocks.x: Day-part demand models per SKU-store feed ordering agents proposing quantities within policy; cold-chain telemetry made compliance continuous; markdown intelligence times reductions against sell-through curves. Store managers approve exceptions; the system learns from every override.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.

items: Prior authorization turnaround down 62% — clinical evidence assembled automatically
Lead time down 58%, AI margin protected — platform engineering plus AI factory

blocks.x: Towers: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics. Platforms: Achala Forge, Achala Swarm, Achala Twinverse.

blocks.caption: Measured outcomes
rows: continuous evidence, zero findings in audit

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
